about_the_game:
Search for your missing brother William, expose the twisted truths lurking in the wards, hide from shadowy Barrens and cloaked Gasts, solve haunting puzzles, and face moral dilemmas that shape your fate—will you become an empathetic savior or a ruthless manipulator?

Step into a vast, eerie place where reality frays at the edges, corridors stretch and fold like paper, clocks run backward in empty rooms, and every shadow seems to remember something you’ve already forgotten. You are Willow, a 13-year-old girl awakening with fractured memories in this unsettling realm. Your brother is nowhere to be found, and everyone insists you should forget him—but something here remembers him too. Strange inhabitants whisper warnings, and your search pulls you deeper into the Hospital’s cursed heart. Something ancient and wrong is watching from the dark.

Explore shifting hallways where time and architecture twist together, gather clues from forgotten objects and fragmented conversations, and decide whom—if anyone—you can trust. Help the entities you encounter to earn their support, or refuse every plea and rely solely on your own wits. Either path may lead you to the truth.

Peer into paper-theater recollections and uncover fragments that slowly reveal the Hospital’s true nature. Will you keep your heart open and find a way out together, or will you do whatever it takes—even if it breaks you? Some doors should stay closed forever… and some memories are safer forgotten.

short_description: Willow's Paper House — a spooky point-and-click mystery adventure where you play as 13-year-old Willow, trapped in a paranormal Hospital. Delve deep into a nightmarish reality to unravel its terrifying secrets before the warped time consumes you forever.
